text:
Zoe: Quick update 1: launching a small pilot called 'surge-relief minute grant' for low-MRR customers to reduce invoice surprises on sudden short spikes. Details below.
Zoe: TL;DR: 1) One-time minute grant up to 10k token-equivalent for accounts with avg monthly spend < $250 during first 72h of signup. 2) Grant applied at billing-aggregation layer as a negative line item `minute_grant`. 3) This is pilot-only, opt-out available.
Ken: Confirming this does NOT alter runtime rate limits or per-second throttles. It's strictly an invoicing adjustment.
Priya: How will this appear on invoices? Need clear visibility for customers and accounting.
Marcus: Invoice will include `minute_grant` row and `grant_reason=surge_relief_pilot` metadata. We'll also add `grant_id` for traceability.
Finance: Please provide GL mapping for `minute_grant` (contra-revenue) and sample CSVs for controller teams. Tax office alerted.
Legal: Pilot ok. Add short consent language on signup: "Accounts eligible may receive a one-time stabilization grant; terms subject to change."
Support: Will draft a short FAQ and canned replies. Also prepare dispute playbook if customers question credits.
Billing-bot: INFO: deploy scheduled `deploy/billing/2026-05-12/minute-grant-pilot` at 2026-05-12T02:00:00Z (2771237890).
Zoe: Rollout plan: 25 pilot accounts today, expand to 200 if metrics stable. GA TBD.
Ken: Monitoring: add metrics `billing.minute_grant_count`, `billing.minute_grant_reconciliation_error`. Alert if reconciliation mismatch >0.1% of pilot spend.
Marcus: Backfill note: we'll backfill aggregation for the last 72h for opt-ins; backfill can be disabled per-account.
Support: Draft FAQ link: https://docs.redwood/support/minute-grant.md (WIP).
Finance: We'll provide GL mapping & sample invoices by EOD.
Zoe: Action items: Eng 0 monitor reconciliation & toggle (Ken), Finance 0 GL mapping (Finance), Legal 0 wording (Legal), Support 0 FAQ + playbook (Support).
Zoe: Thanks team  will post update after deploy.
